in_marathi.name: Asis
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of calmness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Asis हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Asis is the name of the god who personifies calmness, serenity, and peace. He is often depicted as a peaceful deity, seated in meditation or holding a lotus flower. Asis is also believed to be a guardian of the Earth and a supporter of all life.
